meta.thesis: A robot who has read every recipe discovers that baking is not reading.
meta.visual_anchor: a small neighbourhood bakery interior with a wooden counter, one big mixer and a brick oven; the only lettering allowed is the shop's painted sign; no flags, brands or logos; the cast is a boxy robot named Bolt and a baker named Rosa
meta.notes: Illustrative plan for a series episode. The cast is two cut-out puppets animated in code from the series' rigs (characters/bolt, characters/rosa); the one AI image is the bakery background, made once and reused. The series is stylised animation, so the AI label is off by decision; confirm per platform at the series gate. The cliffhanger is on because the user asked for serial endings. The episode declares what changes: location (the bakery), stakes (keeping the job), outcome (the bread rises, the oven goes missing).

beats.layer_why: the title sting is typography and a fixed motif, rendered in code
beats.visual: the title slams in over a paper-flour burst, the series sting plays

beats.text: You have until closing to learn the mixer.
beats.visual: Rosa slides an apron over Bolt's head; the clock above the door reads morning
close on Bolt, eyes bright, an antenna pulsing with each word

beats.layer_why: the bakery background is a set made once and reused; the puppets sit on it
